name: Alamoth
overview: Alamoth is identified in Scripture as a musical term associated with worship, specifically linked to the use of psalteries as seen in 1 Chronicles 15:20. It also serves as an inscription for Psalm 46, a powerful declaration of God's refuge and strength amid turmoil, where the psalmist confidently proclaims God's presence and help even when the earth and mountains are shaken. This connection highlights Alamoth's role in the expressive worship of God's sovereign protection and sustaining power.
